summary.text: Werner Reschke is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 55 who has served in that seat since January 9, 2023, after representing District 56 from 2017 to 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is assistant leader of the House Republican caucus.

paragraphs.text: E. Werner Reschke graduated from Sunset High School and earned a B.A. in business administration from Oregon State University in 1988.
His career experience includes working as a business owner, in sales at Dynatran Software, as a web marketing manager at Tektronix, and as president of a web development company.
He served on the board of directors of the Klamath County Chamber of Commerce.
Reschke succeeded Gail Whitsett in House District 56 in 2017 and Vikki Breese-Iverson in House District 55 in 2023.
On his legislative website, he describes himself as assistant leader of the House Republican caucus, vice chair of House Revenue, and a member of Joint Ways and Means.
He describes District 55 as covering southern Deschutes County and northern and eastern Klamath County, including La Pine, Sunriver and parts of Klamath Falls.
